Requirements:
1. HTML/CSS/JS all inline in one file, no external dependencies
2. 4KB memory with font set at 0x050, programs loaded at 0x200
3. 16 8-bit registers V0-VF, 16-bit index register, program counter, call stack, delay/sound timers counting at 60Hz
4. Complete instruction set: 35+ instructions including:
   - 0x00: Clear screen (0x00E0), Return from subroutine (0x00EE)
   - 0x1xxx: Jump to address
   - 0x2xxx: Call subroutine
   - 0x3xss: Skip if Vx == ss
   - 0x4xss: Skip if Vx != ss
   - 0x5xy0: Skip if Vx == Vy
   - 0x6xss: Set Vx = ss
   - 0x7xss: Add ss to Vx (no carry flag)
   - 0x8xy0: Set Vx = Vy
   - 0x8xy1: Vx = Vx OR Vy
   - 0x8xy2: Vx = Vx AND Vy
   - 0x8xy3: Vx = Vx XOR Vy
   - 0x8xy4: Vx += Vy, carry in VF
   - 0x8xy5: Vx -= Vy, borrow in VF (VF = !(Vx < Vy))
   - 0x8xy6: Vx >>= 1, LSB in VF
   - 0x8xy7: Vx = Vy - Vx, borrow in VF
   - 0x8xyE: Vx <<= 1, MSB in VF
   - 0x9xy0: Skip if Vx != Vy
   - 0xAxxx: Set I = xxx
   - 0xBxxx: Jump to xxx + V0
   - 0xCxss: Vx = random & ss
   - 0xDxys: Draw sprite at (Vx, Vy), height ys, collision in VF
   - 0 Ex0: Skip if key pressed
   - 0 Ex1: Skip if key not pressed
   - 0Fx07: Vx = delay timer
   - 0Fx0A: Wait for key, store in Vx
   - 0Fx15: delay timer = Vx
   - 0Fx18: sound timer = Vx
   - 0Fx1E: I += Vx
   - 0Fx29: I = font sprite address for digit Vx
   - 0Fx33: BCD of Vx stored at I, I+1, I+2
   - 0Fx55: Store V0..Vx in memory starting at I
   - 0Fx65: Load V0..Vx from memory starting at I
5. Display: 64x32 pixels on canvas, scaled up, XOR drawing, collision detection
6. 16-key keypad mapped to 4x4 keyboard keys, shown in interface
7. Key press and release events
8. Demo ROM as byte array - a real program that draws a sprite and moves/reacts to keys
9. Load ROM from local file
10. Controls: run, pause, single step, reset, adjustable speed (instructions per frame)
11. Debugger panel: registers, I, PC, stack, decoded current instruction
12. Every visible control must work

Demo ROM should be a simple program that:
- Draws a sprite on screen
- Moves it with arrow keys or number keys
- Has some basic interaction

Structure the file with:
- CSS in <style> tag
- JS in <script> tag
- HTML structure for display, controls, keypad, debugger"}
